name: Cua huynh de
summary: The yellow, heavily spined crab of Tam Quan and Đề Gi, scarce and called the king of crabs, in season from lunar month 12 to lunar month 3. Steamed, it keeps its sweetness and the roe is rich.
origin: Thị trấn Tam Quan, thị xã Hoài Nhơn, and Đề Gi. The crab is also caught in the waters at Tuy Phong and Sa Huỳnh.
howToEat: Order it salted and braised with rice, steamed with a green-chili salt, or as a porridge of the meat. Steamed is the one that keeps the sweetness.
Come between lunar month 12 and lunar month 3.
where: Tam Quan, Hoài Nhơn, and the Đề Gi coast.
seoTitle: Cua huynh de — the Tam Quan crab
seoDescription: Cua huỳnh đế is the scarce yellow king crab of Tam Quan and Đề Gi, steamed, braised, or in porridge, from lunar month 12 to 3.
